text:
eva_cs: Heads up  EU onboarding pipeline (dedicated pool eu-west) showed elevated latencies and intermittent 502s between 08:579:23 UTC. Affected five inbound onboarding flows; some retries prolonged onboarding by up to 45 minutes for a few accounts.

nate_support: Observed spike in 502s at 08:58, routed diagnostics logs into the incident channel and initiated failover to the global standby pool at 09:05. Error rate dropped but some tenants still seeing longer tail latencies.

hari_eng: Quick summary from infra: a threading regression in the batching scheduler caused backlog under a particular shard key pattern. It led to excessive mem pressure and transient flapping of worker processes. We applied a conservative throttling knob (max_batches=6) and restarted affected workers at 09:12. Patch to scheduler in review; hotfix ETA ~2.5h.

eva_cs: I'm drafting customer-facing comms. Want to include clear mitigations and an offer for remediation help. Please review and suggest edits.

eva_cs: ```Hi <CustomerContact>,

We want to inform you of a service interruption that affected onboarding operations in Redwood Dedicated (EU region) on Mar 25 between 08:579:23 UTC. During that window, some onboarding and ingest requests experienced higher-than-normal latency and intermittent 502 responses. This may have delayed onboarding completion for a small set of customers.

What we did: we activated global failover to an alternative pool, restarted impacted worker processes, and applied temporary batching throttles. We also ran cache priming for active tenants to speed up immediate throughput.

Immediate remediation offered: a 30-minute live troubleshooting session with one of our integration engineers, plus a one-time billing adjustment to address compute consumed during retries. If you prefer, we can also re-run stalled onboarding batches on your behalf.

Next steps: we will share a technical RCA within 48 hours and the permanent fix timeline. Please let us know if you'd like the troubleshooting session or a re-run of your onboarding batches.

Thanks,
Eva (Customer Success) on behalf of Redwood Inference
```

nate_support: Suggest adding a quick self-help bullet: "If you see prolonged retries, reduce batch_size to 4 and/or add a short fixed retry_backoff (e.g., 250ms) while we finish the patch."

hari_eng: Agree; also safe to note that pinning to non-EU pool via Console > Deployments > Region Failover will route your requests to the global pool. For customers with data residency constraints, we will coordinate alternate mitigations before routing.

eva_cs: Good point about data residency  I'll include an explicit note to contact us before enabling cross-region failover.

zoe_billing: Recommended credit phrasing: "We will apply a one-time credit equivalent to estimated compute for the impacted onboarding window, applied to your next bill. If you prefer a custom adjustment, reply and we'll review your usage with you." Legal reviewed and approved the wording.

eva_cs: Thanks Zoe. Also tagging renewals for two tenants with extended delays so we can do a tailored outreach: Tenant IDs T-2045 and T-2099  flag as high-touch.

ops_bot: Incident created: 2026-03-25-EU-Onboard-Pipeline (P2). Incident lead: hari_eng. Links: internal incident page attached.

nate_support: I'll create calibration invites for remediation office hours Mon/Tue 15:00-17:00 UTC and include a short diagnostics checklist: 1) gather oauth logs, 2) sample request payloads, 3) recent retries count.

eva_cs: Final check: tone ok? no overpromising on credits beyond Zoe's language?

eva_cs: Also prepping localized FR/DE versions for EU contacts before send.

hari_eng: Tone good. We should add one more line: "We're prioritizing a regression test to prevent recurrence" and planned verification steps post-deploy.

eva_cs: Will add. Sending now after edits and localization. I'll post the exact copy and recipients in this thread once sent.

zoe_billing: Credit queued for the five affected tenants; billing will apply on next invoice.

eva_cs: Sent to primary contacts for affected tenants. Recap: office hours scheduling in progress, credits confirmed, eng to publish RCA within 48h following patch verification. I'll ping renewals for high-touch follow-through. Thanks all :pray:
